controlChangeCommands.name: Remote Expr
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Factory Remote Expression Pedal. Parameter targets assigned in Neuro Editor. Atlas User Guide MIDI CC table; full map via Device > Edit Device MIDI Map.

controlChangeCommands.name: On/Off
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Factory Engaged/Bypass. Value bands not listed in published Atlas User Guide table; use Neuro Device MIDI Map for ranges. Canonical extremes used here.

controlChangeCommands.name: Recall Bypass
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Factory Preset Recall (OFF). CC value 0–127 selects preset (Neuro display 1–128); recalls bypassed. Prefer Program Change when available. Atlas User Guide / Source Audio MIDI Features.

controlChangeCommands.name: Recall Engage
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Factory Preset Recall (ON). CC value 0–127 selects preset (Neuro display 1–128); recalls engaged. Prefer Program Change when available. Atlas User Guide / Source Audio MIDI Features.

controlChangeCommands.name: Toggle Bypass
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Factory Engaged/Bypass Toggle. Any value toggles engage/bypass. Atlas User Guide MIDI CC table.
